paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, both related to Fermi Inc. receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas. The news items were reported by Bloomberg.com and Bloomberg on August 14, 2026.

Fermi Inc. has filed various forms with the SEC, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as its new Chief Executive Officer. There is also 1 Form 4 filing in the feed. The company has 25 total filings in the feed, including 12 proxy solicitation filings.
